title: Bước chân trên gác
about: A new piece in the dem-diu style (round 12): 96 bpm, A minor held over a pedal A with Bb above it (Phrygian, Bbmaj7/A), a tune of single steps and silences like footsteps overhead over a heartbeat in the bass (pulse), then a circling ostinato as they come nearer: D minor to an unexpected E major, a climax up to E6.
